component.name: Cell
component.script: sub bind() m.top.id=m.top.itemContent.id cells=m.global.cells found=false for each cell in cells if cell.isSameNode(m.top) then found=true end for if not found cells.push(m.top) m.global.cells=cells end if m.top.findNode("rect").width=m.top.width m.top.findNode("rect").height=m.top.height end sub
